title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The reel is silent, which weakens the requested fun mood.
The sampled frames show plain full-screen photos without humorous overlays or other visible playful styling; any bouncy motion or lively transitions cannot be verified from these stills.

judge.summary: An eight-second vertical photo montage is delivered, but the silent presentation shows little evidence of the requested fun treatment.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: A single MP4 is reported as eight seconds long, and its extracted frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The dog, cat, curly-haired woman and mountain lake appear in the output samples; the beach friends are not shown, but could appear between sampled times.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: No playful graphics or overlays are visible, and the sparse still frames do not establish whether playful motion or transitions occur.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The sampled dog, cat and woman are clear and unobscured, but the friends and the full duration of each appearance cannot be checked.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is one MP4 with different full-screen photos appearing at successive timestamps.
